core_obligations: Choose finitely many elements realising the target as a localisation of a subalgebra, and present the source as a colimit of local rings essentially of finite type over Z (proof lines 32510-32525).
Build the approximating local rings and verify the four listed properties, the last one being that each transition presents the next stage as a localisation of a quotient (proof lines 32525-32559).

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a local homomorphism which is essentially of finite type is a colimit of local homomorphisms that are essentially of finite type over Z, with each transition presenting the next stage as a localisation of a quotient of the base change (statement lines 32489-32508). The proof does not argue abstractly: it chooses finitely many elements realising the target as a localisation of a subalgebra, descends them into one stage of a colimit presentation of the source, and checks the four listed properties by hand (proof lines 32510-32560). Keeping the quotients and localisations compatible across stages is the substance, and the author writes the verification out. H2.
